diffs.diff: audio output voltage (V): datasheet reading gives 1 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: The MAX9814 is a purely analog amplifier with no ADC counts or registers; the second reading's 'conversion' is the identity (quantity = output volts, scale 1, offset 0). The model expresses the same thing: sim quantity 'Sound level (Out swing, V peak-to-peak)' in unit V with sim.wave.voltsPerUnit = 1 around centerV 1.23 V, i.e. 1 V of quantity per volt at Out. The gate only reads measure/response/vAtMin-vAtMax scales, and vAtMin = vAtMax = 1.23 V (the DC bias) because the level is the AC swing, not a DC level. Datasheet: MICOUT DC bias 1.23 V typ (1.14-1.32 V); Adafruit: 'Output: 2Vpp on 1.25V bias'. Equivalent units, no change needed.
